summary: NextSync 0.4.0: the account view focuses on your synchronized folders, like the official client.
changelog: The account view now shows only your synchronized folders, each with its own live status (a check when synchronized) and a more (…) menu with: open local folder, edit ignored files, force sync now, pause or resume sync, and remove the folder from synchronization (local files are kept).
The big status header, the account row, the last-sync row, the recent activity expander and the log/conflicts rows were removed from the account view to keep it focused.
Account removal moved to Settings > Advanced behind a typed confirmation (it only removes the connection, never local files).
Primary buttons continue to follow the system GNOME accent color.
